newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Freehold, N.J.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
The Board of Education of the
Township of Freehold
(County of Monmouth)
New Jersey
School Bonds
(Callable) (Book-Entry-Only Bonds)
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Business
Administrator/Board Secretary of The Board of Education of the Township of Freehold in the County of Monmouth, New Jersey at the Board's administrative offices, at 237
Stonehurst Boulevard, Freehold, New Jersey on Tuesday
JULY 8, 1997
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the following Bonds of the School District due (subject to prior redemption) on July 15 in each of the years as follows:
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Board in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Board will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Wilentz, Goldman & Spitzer, P.A., Woodbridge, New Jersey.

The Bonds will be dated July 15, 1997 and will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum specified by the successful bidder in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale, payable on July 15, 1998 and semi- annually thereafter on the fifteenth day of January and July in each year until maturity or earlier redemption.

Each proposal submitted must specify the rate or rates of interest per annum to be borne by the Bonds and the rate or rates named shall be in multiples of one-eighth (1/8) or one-twentieth (1/20) of one (1%) per centum. If more than one rate of interest is named, no interest rate named for any maturity may be less than the interest rate named for any prior maturity and not more than one rate of interest may be named for the Bonds of the same maturity. There is no limitation on the number of rates of interest that may be

named. No proposal will be considered that offers to pa amount less than the total principal amount of Bonds offered for sale or under which the total loan is made at an interest cost higher than the lowest net interest cost to the Board of Education under any legally acceptable
proposal. Each proposal submitted must specify the purchase price for the Bonds, which shall be not less than

$26,900,000 nor more than $26,901,000. The Bonds shall be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost. Such net interest cost shall be computed, as to each bid, by adding the total interest cost to maturity in accordance with such bid and by deduction therefrom of the amount of premium bid, if any. If two or more bidders offer the same lowest net interest cost, the Bonds will be sold to one of such bidders selected by the undersigned by lot from among all such bidders. The purchaser must also pay an amount equal to the interest on the Bonds accrued from the dated date of the Bonds to the date of payment of the purchase price of the Bonds.
The right is reserved to reject all bids, and any bid not complying with the terms of this notice will be rejected.
Each bidder is required to deposit a certified,

treasurer's or cashier's check payable to the order of THE BOARD OF EDUCATION OF THE TOWNSHIP OF FREEHOLD, IN THE COUNTY OF MONMOUTH in the amount of $538,000 drawn upon a bank or trust company, and such check must be enclosed with the proposal.
The full Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official

Statement and the bid forms are available by contacting the Business Administrator/Board Secretary at The Board of Education of the Township of Freehold, 237 Stonehurst Boulevard, Freehold, New Jersey 07728, (732) 866-6802 or the Board's Bond Counsel, Lisa Gorab, Esq., Wilentz, Goldman & Spitzer, P.A., (732) 855-6459.
/s/ Diane Durkin
Business Administrator/Board Secretary
DATED: June 26, 1997
(From The Bond Buyer)
